trap.label: falso cognato
trap.wrong: The court assumes innocence; I presume that for the argument, and it gives rise of doubt.
trap.right: The court presumes innocence; let us assume it for the argument, and it gives rise to doubt.
trap.why: Presume = com indícios/regra; assume = ponto de partida; give rise to leva to.

mcq.q: Which phrase means to produce doubt?

fix.wrong: The judge assumed him innocent by law.
fix.right: The judge presumed him innocent by law.
It gives rise to a doubt.

fix.wrong: I presume it for the sake of argument.
fix.right: I assume it for the sake of argument.

rewrite.prompt: Troque por presume: “The law takes him as innocent.”
Troque por assume: “Suppose it is true, for argument.”
rewrite.answer: Assume it is true, for argument.
